scope: Tracked authored web source and first-party HTML; dynamic user content, upstream messages, generated/vendor assets and native-app resources require separate review.
method: Tracked-source AST inventory includes Korean, JSX text and English copy properties. Candidates are not equivalent to rendered phrases: machine keys, prompts, examples, templates and editorial/legal content are explicitly separated. Correct short copy is preserved rather than mechanically replaced.
language: Korean users/app/school administration; English desktop platform/developer/equipment portals. Keep the established brand and time-based greeting voice.
invariants: No account, school membership, permission or data migration
No production registrations, emails, reservations, GPU jobs or row writes for verification
Public assets and the web artifact deployed separately from backend services
